subject: Standby capacity escrow request for Aurora Consortium (late-stage)
messages:
From: Lena Park <lena@auroraconsortium.com>
To: irene.choi@redwoodinference.com
Cc: ops@auroraconsortium.com
Date: Tue, 8 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request to place standby capacity escrow for late-stage procurement

Hi Irene,

We're in late-stage procurement with Aurora Consortium's platform team and want to request a short-term standby/escrow of capacity while we finalize commercial and security paperwork. The ask is: 12x A100 equivalent GPUs for a 90-day standby window starting mid-August, across us-west region (burst allowed but prefer reservation). This is to guarantee availability for a production ramp once contracts sign.

We can sign the mutual MOU template and provide the PO on signature. Can Redwood put a soft hold or escrow on that capacity and block it from general allocation until we either convert or release? Please let me know what you need from our side (PO timeline, billing contact, or a DocuSign MOU).

Thanks,
Lena
Lena Park
Head of Platform Partnerships
Aurora Consortium
lena@auroraconsortium.com

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lena Park <lena@auroraconsortium.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Jul 2025 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Request to place standby capacity escrow for late-stage procurement

Thanks Lena — looping in Ben and Rishi to confirm feasibility and next steps. Quick context for the thread: Aurora (deal AC-2025-0012) is asking for a 90-day standby of 12 A100-equivalent GPUs in us-west, start mid-August, soft-commit with MOU/PO to follow.

Ben — can you confirm whether sales can provision a soft hold for that spec and what commercial terms (minimum spend / fee) we should propose for a 90-day escrow?

Rishi — please check inventory/ops availability for mid-August through November and advise on whether we can isolate that slice (either reserved nodes or a capacity tag + governor) and on the process to mark those nodes as escrowed. If we need to set up a fallback plan (model variant or cross-region), flag it here.

Lena — attaching a lightweight MOU template (Aurora_MOU_standby_template.pdf) for reference.

Appreciate quick turnaround — Aurora wants an answer this week.

Best,
Irene Choi
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwoodinference.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lena Park <lena@auroraconsortium.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Jul 2025 14:27:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Request to place standby capacity escrow for late-stage procurement

Quick response — commercial side: we can offer a 90-day standby with a tiered escrow fee (25% of estimated monthly committed spend prepaid, refundable upon conversion or applied to first invoice). For a 12x A100 equivalent footprint the rough list monthly cost is $120k; escrow fee would be $30k prepaid. We can tighten numbers after Rishi confirms operational costs.

Operationally I need a snapshot of available pods and whether we can mark them with a reserved tag or set up a node-level reservation. Attached is a current capacity snapshot (capacity_snapshot_20250708.csv) for inventory context. If Rishi confirms we can isolate a contiguous 12-GPU allocation, sales is OK to push the MOU/DocuSign flow.

Action items:
- Rishi: confirm physical node availability and isolation risk (cross-tenant implications).
- Irene: share preferred MOU terms if Aurora requests any deviations.

Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lena Park <lena@auroraconsortium.com>
Date: Wed, 9 Jul 2025 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Request to place standby capacity escrow for late-stage procurement

Irene / team — operational check complete. Summary:
- We have sufficient headroom in us-west to cover a 12x A100-equivalent standby from 2025-08-15 to 2025-11-13, provided we allocate across two nodes (6 GPUs per node) to optimize thermal and scheduling constraints.
- Isolation approach: apply a "standby" capacity tag + quota reservation at the scheduler level; this will prevent new dynamic placements and route matching requests away from those nodes. We recommend the soft-hold period be enforced via a reservation ticket in the capacity manager (RES-AC-2025-0012).
- Risk/fallback: if immediate physical contention arises, automatic fallback is to redirect to a compatible quantized instance (8 A100-equivalent via batching/quantization) in us-west or failover to us-east with a 150ms latency delta.

I will open the reservation ticket (RES-AC-2025-0012) and mark nodes with the tag. Next steps: Ben to confirm escrow fee and Irene to approve the MOU variation; once signed we'll provision the reservation and send confirmation. I'll attach the reservation ticket reference here after creation.

Rishi Malhotra
Capacity Operations Lead, Redwood Inference
